adjudication.rationale: In the new controller spec, the "cannot remove members from automatic groups" example calls `xhr :put, :remove_member, ...` even though the routes map `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` and `put "members" => "groups#add_members"` (config/routes.rb). However, in a controller spec `:remove_member` is invoked directly, so it does not actually "route to add_members"; the automatic-group guard in `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` would still run. The real issue is the test not using the correct HTTP verb / not exercising the real route mapping.
